title: RegNetY-008 5-fold (recipe R, 224 train)
hypothesis: A small efficient RegNet might be a diverse ensemble member.

results.name: OOF (v4+rot)
results.note: evaluated at inference res 320 (see EXP-021 style sweep)

findings: RegNetY-008 reaches OOF 0.7218 at inference 320, below ResNet18d (EXP-013) at 224 (0.7524).
Adding it to R_r18d+R_e600 at 320 did not help on full OOF (0.8095 vs 0.8089, with balance 0.8152 vs 0.8155).
limitations: Overall OOF at 224 was not recorded separately; the 0.7218 value is at 320.

evidence.code: Training code is in code/ (copied from the team server export, 2026-11-12). Referenced by md5: train.py 56d4db01cdd6c2c46e7b9b3b789324fe (before the 2026-11-12 patch that added --img and corrupt_v5; default behaviour unchanged), dq.py e3e270bdcdf254ad369b1cb3c345e5e9.
